content:
| Stage | Status | Description | 
| 100 | | I'm picking up a strange broadcast in the Mire region called 'Linda-Lee Shortwave Signal'. I should listen to the mysterious broadcast to see what's going. | 
| 150 | | The broadcast was of a strange voice asking for help with something about catching fish? I didn't hear all of it, but I could work out the name 'Fisherman's Rest', a spot located in the Mire region. I should head over and investigate. | 
| 151 | | I found a strange note outside of Vault 76 pinned to a barrel. It mentioned that there are 'anglers wanted' for some sort of job and that those interested should visit Fisherman's Rest in the Mire. I should go there and see what I can find. | 
| 200 | | I've arrived at Fisherman's Rest. There appears to be a strange creature here and a giant hermit crab. I should speak to him to find out what he wants. | 
| 300 | | The creature seems to be a fisherman, of sorts. He doesn't appear to speak, but he did point me towards his friend. Maybe I'll have better luck talking to him. | 
| 400 | | I spoke to the creature's friend, a sea captain named Raymond. There's something not quite right with him, but I can't say for sure. He's asked me to catch some fish for him and said that I should get the equipment from the creature. | 
| 500 | | Now I've got a fishing rod and some bait, I should be ready to go and catch the three fish the Captain asked for. If I run out of bait, I should be able to buy more from the Fisherman or the Captain. | 
| 600 | | I've caught all three fish. I should return to Fisherman's Rest and show the Captain what I've got. | 
| 700 | | I showed the Captain the fish I caught for him, but he didn't seem very impressed with them. He's asked me to feed them to the giant hermit crab on the island, Linda-Lee. | 
| 800 | | I've prepared the fish I caught and chopped them up into Fish Bits at the cooking station like Captain Raymond asked. All that's left is to feed them to the giant crab, carefully. | 
| 900 | | I fed the giant hermit crab and she spat something out in return. It's a bit slimy, but still in working condition. I should head back to Captain Raymond to tell him about it. | 
| 9000 | ![Quest finished Quest finished](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/a/a9/FO76_icon_xpd_yellowcheck.png/15px-FO76_icon_xpd_yellowcheck.png) | Completed Quest |
